t: The Quarry Card makes the Builder mine all blocks in the selected area. Normal quarry cards replace mined blocks with the configured filler block.
采掘卡片使建筑机挖掘所选区域内的全部方块。普通采掘卡片会将已挖掘方块替换为设定的填充方块。
Clear variants leave air instead of filler. Silk Touch variants preserve blocks, while Fortune variants improve drops where possible.
清除变体会以空气替代而非填充物；精准采集变体会保留原方块；幸运变体则在可能情况下提升掉落物品质。
